description_short: Smart electric power governor. Automatically manages and pauses heavy consumers based on grid capacity to prevent blackouts.
description_long: Power Threshold Governor An intelligent electrical load-shedding and power management system for Captain of Industry. Protect your factory from catastrophic blackout death spirals by automatically pausing non-critical, heavy consumers during fuel or power shortages, and smoothly bringing them back online in controlled stages. Key Features: • ⚡ Global Rules Tab: Configure pause thresholds for every electric consumer on the island—either as a percentage of total grid capacity (%) or exact power output (MW). • 📊 Live Island Telemetry: Displays the real-time count of built machines on the island and their live power consumption alongside maximum potential draw (e.g. 36 MW / 81 MW). • ⏸ Paused Buildings Tab: Grouped overview of all currently throttled machines with one-click bulk resume buttons. • 🛡️ Staged Grid Restoration: Sophisticated blackout loop prevention. When power recovers, the governor safely tests one machine at a time with instant deficit abort and backoff cooldowns to prevent rapid on/off flickering. • 🔧 Local Machine Inspector Overrides: Click any machine on the map to set custom, instance-specific threshold overrides directly in its native inspector panel. • 🖱️ Easy Access: Accessible via top HUD power button, Alt + P, or F8. Compatible with vanilla saves — safely added to or removed from existing saves.
